notes.subject: מנון
notes.rationale: מנון appears only here in the Tanakh; meaning uncertain.

notes.subject: מנון
notes.rationale: Renderings split: 'son/heir' (KJV, ASV, Geneva), 'rebel' (Wycliffe), 'grief' (BSB), 'continuator' (YLT); from root נון 'to continue/flourish'.

notes.subject: pamperim
notes.rationale: מפנק is a participle of פנק 'to enervate, indulge' — the agent-noun shape is softened into a verb phrase.

translation: Man i pamperim gutpela ⟨את⟩ save man bilong em long taim em i liklik yet, na long behain bai save man i kamap olsem man i save holim nem bilong em.
